table_of_contents: Consolidated starter catalogue for scheme discovery and grounded assistance. Not a substitute for official eligibility decisions.
Purpose, coverage, field definitions and safe-use rules
One record per scheme/programme with summary, eligibility, documents and application route
Official URLs, source type, verification status and last-checked date
Insurance/assurance vs cash assistance vs service programme vs digital health
State-dependent and unverified fields must be checked before definitive guidance
This is a curated starter catalogue, not an exhaustive list of all Indian schemes.
Entries marked NEEDS_* or PARTIALLY_VERIFIED require official-source review before production use.
Use official source documents as PageIndex evidence. Do not use catalogue metadata as conclusive proof for personalized eligibility.
Compilation date: 2026-09-30. Re-verify rules before production deployment.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.normalized_name: ayushman bharat pradhan mantri jan arogya yojana (ab-pmjay)
schemes.brief_details: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover at empanelled hospitals. Standard cover is up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year, subject to applicable rules and package limits.
schemes.eligibility: Eligibility for most beneficiaries is based on the applicable beneficiary database and scheme rules. Separately, Indian citizens aged 70+ are eligible under the senior-citizen expansion regardless of income; Aadhaar-based e-KYC is required for that enrolment.
schemes.required_documents: For 70+ enrolment: Aadhaar for e-KYC. For other beneficiaries, carry accepted identity and family/beneficiary details; exact requirements depend on the verification channel.
schemes.where_to_apply: Check eligibility and enrol through the official beneficiary portal or Ayushman App; alternatively visit a CSC or empanelled hospital/Ayushman Mitra.
schemes.source_type: National Health Authority official portal and FAQ
schemes.notes: 70+ details supported by official NHA FAQ. Verify other beneficiary rules against current official guidance.

schemes.scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
schemes.normalized_name: chief minister's comprehensive health insurance scheme (cmchis)
schemes.brief_details: Tamil Nadu programme providing cashless treatment for covered procedures at empanelled hospitals, subject to packages and current rules.
schemes.eligibility: Tamil Nadu resident family; official eligibility page states annual family income below ₹1,20,000. Family-member inclusion is subject to scheme rules and ration-card records.
schemes.required_documents: Income certificate, family ration card and Aadhaar are listed in official eligibility guidance. Additional proof may be requested.
schemes.where_to_apply: Visit the designated CMCHIS card-issuing/enrolment centre at the District Collector's Office with required documents; consult the official portal.
schemes.source_type: Government of Tamil Nadu CMCHIS official portal
schemes.notes: Use current portal and government orders for final decisions. Older pages may show superseded income limits.

schemes.brief_details: Contributory social security scheme for covered employees, including medical care and specified cash benefits under the ESI Act and regulations.
schemes.eligibility: Employees in covered establishments/notified areas who meet applicable wage ceiling and coverage conditions. Verify the current wage ceiling and establishment coverage.
schemes.required_documents: ESI insurance number/e-Pehchan details, identity and family/dependent details as requested by ESIC.
schemes.where_to_apply: Coverage is generally initiated through the employer's ESIC registration. Access care through the assigned ESIC dispensary/hospital.
schemes.source_type: ESIC official website and Citizen's Charter
schemes.notes: Do not hardcode wage ceiling without checking latest ESIC notification.

schemes.brief_details: Healthcare scheme providing eligible beneficiaries access to wellness centres and empanelled providers under CGHS rules.
schemes.eligibility: Central Government employees, eligible pensioners and other notified categories, subject to current rules and city/service conditions.
schemes.required_documents: Proof of eligible employment or pension status, identity details, family/dependent details and documents specified in current application process.
schemes.where_to_apply: Apply through official CGHS online services or designated CGHS wellness centre/office, as applicable.
schemes.source_type: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare CGHS portal
schemes.notes: Confirm current beneficiary categories, contribution rates, city availability and process.

schemes.brief_details: Financial assistance framework for eligible patients from poor families with specified life-threatening diseases, subject to current guidelines and fund availability.
schemes.eligibility: Poor patients meeting income and treatment conditions in current RAN guidelines; covered institutions, diseases and exclusions must be checked.
schemes.required_documents: Income/poverty proof, medical certificate and estimate from treating government hospital, identity and prescribed forms; additional items may apply.
schemes.where_to_apply: Follow the prescribed process through the treating government hospital and relevant Ministry of Health and Family Welfare channel.
schemes.source_type: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare official portal
schemes.notes: Not automatic insurance coverage. Verify current disease list, ceilings and application channel.

schemes.brief_details: Safe motherhood programme providing conditional cash assistance for eligible pregnant women for institutional delivery.
schemes.eligibility: Pregnant women meeting applicable state/UT category, age, parity and other current JSY conditions; rules vary by state/UT.
schemes.required_documents: Pregnancy/MCP card or ANC records, identity and bank details, plus state-required eligibility documents.
schemes.where_to_apply: Contact local ASHA/ANM, primary health centre or government health facility; follow state health department process.
schemes.notes: Amounts and eligibility vary; do not generalize a single amount.

schemes.brief_details: Entitlements intended to provide free/cashless services for pregnant women and sick newborns/infants in public institutions, according to guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Pregnant women and sick newborns/infants covered by current JSSK rules; confirm exact scope from national/state guidance.
schemes.required_documents: Pregnancy/MCP card or child health records and identity/facility records where available. Confirm local requirements.
schemes.where_to_apply: Access services at eligible government health facilities; contact facility help desk, ANM or ASHA.
schemes.notes: Verify current entitlements and local implementation.

schemes.category: Child health screening and early intervention
schemes.brief_details: Child health screening and early intervention addressing defects at birth, diseases, deficiencies and developmental delays including disabilities.
schemes.eligibility: Children in age groups and settings covered by current RBSK guidelines, including newborns and children reached through public health and educational platforms.
schemes.required_documents: Child identity/age details and available health or school records; facility may specify additional records.
schemes.where_to_apply: Contact an RBSK mobile health team, Anganwadi centre, government school or public health facility, depending on age and location.
schemes.notes: Confirm operational age groups, referral pathways and local availability.

schemes.brief_details: Programme focused on correcting regional imbalances in tertiary healthcare and improving medical education through institutions such as AIIMS and upgraded government medical colleges.
schemes.eligibility: Not an individual enrolment-based insurance benefit. Patients access services at participating institutions under institution-specific rules.
schemes.required_documents: Hospital registration documents and clinical records as required by the treating institution; no general scheme beneficiary card.
schemes.where_to_apply: Contact the relevant participating AIIMS or upgraded government medical college for patient registration and service details.
schemes.notes: Healthcare infrastructure, not insurance. Include only if discovery supports non-insurance programmes.

schemes.scheme_name: National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD; formerly NPCDCS)
schemes.normalized_name: national programme for prevention and control of non-communicable diseases (np-ncd; formerly npcdcs)
schemes.brief_details: Public health programme supporting prevention, screening, early diagnosis and management of major non-communicable diseases.
schemes.eligibility: People accessing participating public facilities; screening follows programme protocols and age/risk criteria.
schemes.required_documents: Identity details and available prior medical records; requirements vary by facility.
schemes.where_to_apply: Visit a participating Ayushman Arogya Mandir, PHC, CHC or designated government facility.
schemes.notes: Not insurance. Verify current programme name, age criteria and local availability.

schemes.brief_details: Programme supporting access to dialysis through designated public facilities and PPP arrangements, subject to state implementation.
schemes.eligibility: Patients requiring dialysis who meet service and facility conditions in the relevant state/UT.
schemes.required_documents: Doctor's referral/clinical assessment, diagnostic records and identity or registration details as required by facility.
schemes.where_to_apply: Contact district hospital or designated public dialysis centre to confirm availability, registration and charges.
schemes.notes: Availability, charges and referral requirements differ by state and facility.

schemes.brief_details: Tamil Nadu initiative supporting emergency treatment for eligible road-accident victims at designated hospitals, subject to current rules.
schemes.eligibility: Road-accident victims meeting current Tamil Nadu programme conditions and receiving care at designated hospitals; verify current limits.
schemes.required_documents: Emergency/accident and hospital records; identity details if available. Do not delay emergency stabilization to obtain documents.
schemes.where_to_apply: Seek immediate care at a designated participating hospital and ask the scheme desk to confirm eligibility and formalities.
schemes.source_type: Government of Tamil Nadu CMCHIS official portal
schemes.notes: Confirm current coverage amount, time window, participating hospitals and process.

schemes.brief_details: Digital health account identifier to help individuals link and manage records in participating digital health services. It is not insurance and does not itself guarantee free treatment.
schemes.eligibility: Individuals can create an ABHA under current ABDM registration rules; record linking is subject to participation and consent.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar or another supported identity/verification method, depending on current creation flow.
schemes.where_to_apply: Use the official ABHA/ABDM portal or supported health applications and facilities.
schemes.source_type: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission official portal
schemes.notes: Digital health infrastructure, not insurance; ABHA does not itself confer PM-JAY/CMCHIS eligibility.
